title: Closing Worksheet: Total Lender Credits on the Initial Closing Disclosure of a Mortgage Loan File
content:
**Worksheet rule.** The standard lender credit on an initial Closing Disclosure of a Mortgage Loan File is the application fee collected on the file where the program credits that fee at closing, plus the lender credit disclosed on the initial Loan Estimate (0.00 where the initial Loan Estimate shows none).

**How the credits are put together.** All the credits are added together once, in dollars, and the total is rounded to the cent.

**Terms of the worksheet.**

- *Application fee collected* — the application fee collections on the file's fee ledger, where the program the file is in credits the collected application fee back at closing (every Larkspur program does so except the Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed); where the program does not, no application fee credit enters.
- *Initial Loan Estimate lender credit* — the lender credit amount disclosed on the file's initial Loan Estimate, as recorded in its disclosure history; 0.00 where it shows none.

## Standard lender credit worked through (hypothetical files)

| Program | Application fee collected | Initial Loan Estimate lender credit | Standard lender credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 450.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 950.00 USD |
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 300.00 USD | none shown (0.00) | 300.00 USD |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 695.00 USD (not credited at closing) | 1250.00 USD | 1250.00 USD |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | none (program charges no application fee) | 750.00 USD | 750.00 USD |
